newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Surry nuke seen down several days.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Surry nuke seen down several days.

text.p: Virginia Power Co should restart its 781 megawatt Surry nuclear power unit 1 within several days following a shutdown to repair a leak in a steam pipe, a company spokesman said Friday.
"It could be a matter of a few days" before the unit resumes power production, spokesman Jim Norvelle said.
The unit was shut Friday morning to repair a pinhole leak in a small steam pipe which runs from the steam generator to the unit's turbine, Norvelle said.
The adjacent 781 megawatt Surry nuclear unit 2, also located in Gravel Neck, Va., continued to operate normally at 100 percent of power, Norvelle said.
Virginia Power was likely continuing power sales, although at a reduced level, despite the outage, the spokesman said.
In addition to electricity sales, Virginia Power normally purchases an average of about 25 percent of its power, Norvelle said.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources Inc.
